learn.name: OID Integration Blueprint — Developer Guide
learn.tagline: Integrate Globally-Unique Identifiers Into Your Systems A comprehensive technical guide for developers and architects who need to embed OIDs (Object Identifiers
learn.description:
Integrate Globally-Unique Identifiers Into Your Systems A comprehensive technical guide for developers and architects who need to embed OIDs (Object Identifiers) into production systems. Built on BrainSAIT's IANA-registered PEN 61026 namespace, this guide delivers six complete integration patterns with copy-paste-ready code. What's Included

 FHIR Extension Pattern — StructureDefinition templates for NPHIES-compliant resource tagging

 MCP URN Pattern — Tool metadata for AI agent systems and multi-agent architectures

 X.509 Certificate OID — Certificate signing configuration with OID policy extensions

 API Header Standard — HTTP header conventions for service identity across microservices

 Database Schema Pattern — PostgreSQL and SQL Server OID column definitions with indexes

 QR / RFID Encoding — Physical asset tag data structures and scanner format specs
 Code Examples Every pattern includes working code in JavaScript, Python, CURL, and SQL. Bilingual (AR/EN) documentation throughout. Instant digital delivery. A BrainSAIT technical guide from the OID Registry Platform.

learn.description:
Physical OID Scanning with ESP32 Complete firmware and wiring guide to build a hardware QR code scanner that reads BrainSAIT OID tags and integrates with the OID Registry Platform. Ideal for asset management, equipment tracking, and healthcare device identification. Supported Hardware

 ESP32-CAM (AI-Thinker) — Built-in camera module, no additional scanner required

 ESP32 + GM65 Module — Dedicated barcode/QR scanner module for higher reliability
 Optional OLED/LCD display for immediate scan feedback
 What's Included
 Complete .ino firmware (Arduino IDE / PlatformIO)
 Wiring diagrams for both hardware configurations
 OID validation and HTTP API integration code
 WiFi provisioning and BrainSAIT API endpoint configuration
 Display output code for OLED/LCD modules
 Step-by-step flashing and calibration guide
 Use Cases Hospital equipment tagging · Lab sample tracking · Server rack asset management · Document provenance scanning Instant digital delivery. Firmware source + documentation. Hardware components purchased separately.
